notes.title: Circular Fallacy v1.02 Update: Bug Fixes and Added FOV Adjustment in Settings
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

Recently, we’ve made some optimizations based on the feedback received and reported bugs.

Bug Fixes:

Fixed an issue where progress could not be saved after exiting when a password card was present.

Fixed text issues in Chapter 1 and Chapter 3.

Fixed an issue with the prompt display when checking the time.

Fixed desktop display issues under high resolutions.

New Features:

Added a “Field of View” adjustment option in the settings, allowing you to customize the in-game FOV.

Thanks again for all your feedback! If you encounter any more issues, please keep sharing them with me—I’ll fix them as soon as possible, tabbycat!!ːtabbycatː

notes.title: Bug Fixes in the Demo Version
notes.notes:
Update & Fixes:

Fixed bug where desktop cards were not cleared after returning to the main menu

Fixed overlapping animations

Fixed hand display issue in Level 2

Temporarily disabled branch storyline

Fixed bug preventing the tutorial from starting in a new game

TabbyCat thanks everyone for the feedback!

If you encounter any other bugs during gameplay, feel free to join our group and let us know!

Group ID: Discord

We'll fix them right away! wwːtabbycatː
